contract: Compile-phase diagnose may opt into nonempty additional_spans objects with a line and optional end_line, all in the existing declared diagnostic input.
The original primary span remains required. A retained sidecar's original statement marker must still lie in its primary span.
All spans use exact positive integer endpoints, end no earlier than start, and stay within the source's one-past-final-record position.
Primary and additional intervals cannot overlap or repeat. Adjacent disjoint intervals remain distinct rather than merging into a larger accepted range.
Every reported point/range must fit inside one individual span. Gap points and cross-anchor recovery ranges cannot qualify.
All anchors share a nonempty causal selector, actual staged source, exclusions, severity/nonfatal/code conditions and global native-failure gates.
Additional entries cannot name another file or replace the common cause. Unsupported success/reject/link/run uses explicitly fail.
Omission preserves existing data and primary-span behavior; no existing contract or fingerprint acquires a default field.
